content: Nuh loi Allar wadar sukti
Allaye Nuh edde hibar futaindore duwa goriyore hodde, "Fólwala o, edde beši o edde duniyai furon goro.

Duniyair hár zandar zanuwar okkol, edde asmanor hár faik okkol, ar zobinot buke aṛede zandar okkol, ar doriyar hár mas okkol tũwarar ḍor edde bóiye sola fira goribo; ar hin okkolore tũwarar hatot diya oiye.
Hár kissu ziyãta edde lorasora gorede zanuwar okkol tũwaralla haiddo oibo. Ãi age zendilla tũwarare hak šobzi haiddo hisabe diyilam hendilla ehon in okkol o dilam.
"Kintu foranwala gusto mani lou šoho gusto no há foribo.

Honokiye zodi tũwarare kun gore toile ãi hameka tũwarar louwor bodole hitar lou mani hitar foranor dabi goriyum. Hiba fokšu ok ba manuš ok. Ar manušor foran ze manuše lo, hitar foran o lowa oibo, iyan ãr dabi.

content.text: manuše o hitar lou bair goribo,

content: Ar tũwara fólwala o, edde beši o, duniyair sairo mikka šiṛi foro edde heṛe o aro beši o."
Bade Allaye Nuh edde hibar futaindore hodde:
"So, tũwara edde tũwarar bongšo okkol loi edde tũwarar fũwati asede hár zandar zanuwar okkol,
faik fokšu, górwali zanuwar edde fahari zanuwar, duniyait zeto ḍoilla zandar zanuwar okkol zahazottu niyoli aišše, hitara loi ãi ãr wadar sukti buwaiyum.

Ãi tũwarar loi ãr wadar sukti buwair: Ar honodin endilla no oibo; fanir bottuwanor duwara hár foranwala zandar okkolore dongšo gora no oibo. Ar duniyaire dongšo gorifelaibolla ar hono din fanir bottuwan no oibo."
Allaye aro hodde, "Tũwara edde tũwarar fũwati asede hár zandar zanuwar okkol edde ãr maze ze wadar sukti buwair, hiyanor sinno oilde iyan, ziyan bongšor bade bongšo dori solat takibo,
he bebostar sinno hisabe miyulat, ãi ãr donu dehaiyum. Hiyan oibo duniyai loi, ãr he wadar suktir sinno.
Ãi zẽtte duniyair uwore miyula dola goriyum, hẽtte donugan miyulat deha dibo,
henot tũwara edde hár zandar zanuwar loi, ãr ei wadar hota ãi monot goriyum. Ar hono din hár zandar dongšo oibolla fanir tuwan no oibo.
Miyulat zehon donugan deha zaibo, henot ãi hiyanor mikka saiyum, henot duniyair hár zandar okkol loi, ãr azibonor wadare monot goriyum."
Tarfore Allaye Nuhure hodde, "Duniyait hár zandar okkol loi ãi buwaiyide wadar suktir sinno oilde iyan."
Nuhur futain okkol
Nuhur ze futain okkol zahazottu niyoli aišše, hitara oilde Šem, Ham edde Yafet. (Ham aššilde Kenanor baf.)
Itara oilde Nuhur futain okkol; itarar bongšo šara duniyai sorai gilgoi.
Bade Nuhuye al saš gora šuru goijje edde ekkan ãngur keti goijje.
Hibaye ekdin šoraf fiyore matal oiye edde nizor ṭambur butore lenḍa oi fori roiye.
Kenanor baf Hame hitar bafor ei abosta deikke edde baire zai hitar dui báiyore hin zanaiye.
Kintu Šem edde Yafete ekkan hor handot felai loiyore fissa aṛi zaiyore hitarar bafor lenḍa gare guridiye. Hitarar muk fissa firaiya aššilde hetolla hitara bafor lenḍa gare no deke.
Bade Nuh šorafor gúmottu uṛiyore hibar šoṛo fute hiba loi goijjede he befare zani faijje,
hibaye hodde,
Bor tuwan bade Nuhuye aro tin šo fõnzaš bosor baisse.
Beggun mili Nuh šaro no šot bosor baisse, toi bade hibar moron oiye.
